out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED HAND SINK AT BAR WITHOUT PAPER TOWELS. OBSERVED TWO HAND SINKS IN KITCHEN WHERE DISPENSER WAS NOT WORKING PROPERLY.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW BEEF PATTIES ON SHELF ABOVE PREMADE CHEESE PIZZAS ON SPEEDRACK IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW BEEF PATTIES TO BOTTOM OF SPEED RACK.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS ON CAN OPENER.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM TOOK CAN OPENER OUT OF SERVICE AND HAD IT RAN THROUGH DISH MACHINE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RAW BEEF PATTY AND SLICED CHEDDAR CHEESE IN #6 - 2 DWR AT 44F AND 45F; LETTUCE IN #9 - 1 DR UC AT 43F; CUT CABBAGE, SPROUTS IN WIC #2 T 44F AND 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED ALL FOODS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: “EGGS ANY STYLE” ON BREAKFAST MENU.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CFM REMOVED MENU AND DISPLAYED PREVIOUS MENU WITH CORRECTED CONSUMER ADVISORY ON EGGS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. SPRAY BOTTLE OF SANITIZER AT SERVER STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH CHEMICAL NAME.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: FROZEN BACON ON COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE BACON TO WIC.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 DR HOT CABINET, 2 DR UC AT COFFEE COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM PLACED THERMOMETER IN UNITS. Hilton Fairfax (Inspection Date: 08/25/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed dishes ran through dish machine and thermolabel did not turn black to indicate proper hot water sanitizing temperature of 160F or above. violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. PIC troubleshooted dish machine. Irreversible thermometer observed at 182F. PIC will have dish employee rerun all dishes previously washed. Hilton Fairfax (Inspection Date: 08/19/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed spinach pastry in coffee bar countertop display at 66F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Food Establishmend Prohibited from ROP of Fish
violations.observation: The following fresh, not frozen, fish are packaged using the Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) method: salmon.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment may not package fresh fish (raw, unfrozen) using a ROP method. PIC advised to cease all ROP of salmon. Discard all ROP salmon.

violations.title: ROP, HACCP Plan in Place
violations.observation: The establishment does not have an approved HACCP plan for the food that is packaged using the Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) process. Observed ROP raw ribeye steaks dated 8/13.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment that packages a time/temperature control for safe food using a Reduced Oxygen Packaging method shall have a HACCP plan that contains the information specified under 8-201.14(D) and that: 1) identifies the food to be packaged, 2) requires that the packaged food shall be maintained at 41F or less, has a water activity of 0.91 or less, a pH of 4.6 or less, is a meat or poultry product that is cured at a food processing plant, is received in an intact package, or is a food with a high level of competing organisms, 3) describes how the package shall be prominently and conspicuosly labeled on the principal display panel in bold type on a contrasting background with instructions to maintain the food at 41F or below and discard the food if within 14 calendar days of its packaging, 40 limits the refrigerated shelf life to no more than 14 calendar days from packaging to consumption or the origjnal manufacturer's 'sell by' or 'use by' date whichever occurs first, 5) includes operational procedures that prohibit contacting food with bare hands, identifies a designated work area and the method by which physical barriers or methods of separation minimizes cross contamination, access to the processing equipment is limited to responsible trained personnel, and cleaning and sanitizing procedures for equipment/utensils is monitored, and 6) describes the training program that ensures that the individual responsible for the ROP operation understands the concepts required for a safe operation, understands the equipment and facilites, and procedures specified in this section. EHS discussed with PIC required HACCP plan and documentation if establishment would like to keep ROP ribeye for more than 48 hours. EHS discussed that ribeyes can be ROP so long as they are 1) labelled with date and TIME, held at 41F or less during storage, AND removed from the ROP packaging within 48 hours. EHS discussed that placing ROP ribeyes in freezer will stop 48 hour clock. When ROP ribeyes are removed from freezer, the packaging must be marked with start of thaw the date and time. Thawed ribeyes must be used within 48 hours of original date and time. PIC will discuss with chef the allowed ROP process for ribeyes without a HACCP plan requirement. Ribeyes were discarded.

violations.title: DOK Major Allergens
violations.observation: The CFM was not familiar with operations in the kitchen regarding how to use the sanitizer dispenser, prepared food date marking system, high temperature dishwasher, etc.
violations.corrective_action: EHS EDUCATED CFM.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the bar with a concentration of less than 50ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: EHS observed the highest temperature of 153°F on the irreversible registering thermometer indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EHS INFORMED CFM THAT THE MACHINE CAN BE USED TO WASH EQUIPMENT, HOWEVER, THE EQUIPMENT MUST BE SUBMERGED IN THE SANITIZER FOR AT LEAST ONE MINUTE PRIOR TO AIR DRYING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: in the Avantco fridge cooked chicken wings dated 2/10, and cooked chicken in a bag dated 2/10.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. DISCARDED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: in the walk in cooler 1 a pan of cooked chicken breast and a pan of cooked chicken wings.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.
